verifier_entrypoint_pin_note: verifier_entrypoint is the pinned console-script target declared in [project.scripts] of pyproject.toml. It is not 'main', not 'latest', and not an unpinned package range: the exact behavior is fixed to the arcs-verify package version and git commit recorded alongside it in each report and execution record.
deterministic_environment_assumptions: the pinned envelope schema file arcs_verify/data/srs-envelope-v0.2.0.schema.json must hash to d03aad1d5517e2acb65d5c866905aed7219bcbbfadd1a4a97eac546dd23f0333 (the schema_digest verdict fails otherwise)
commit_pinning_note: verifier_commit MUST be the exact full git commit SHA (40 lowercase hex characters) of the arcs-verify checkout that performed the invocation. It is supplied explicitly by the caller (see --verifier-commit on the dagr-report subcommand) rather than introspected at runtime, because an installed package may not carry a .git directory. 'main', 'latest', mutable branch refs, and unpinned version ranges are never valid execution identity.
golden_regeneration_note: The golden/ fixtures in this contract directory were generated against the feat/dagr-srs-verifier-report-contract-v0-1 feature-branch commit at authoring time. Per repository precedent (see docs/VERSIONING.md), before this contract is treated as merged-authoritative, the golden verification-report and verification-execution-record fixtures MUST be regenerated against the final reviewed PR head and then reconciled to the squash-merge commit.
not_authenticated_note: Neither this execution contract nor the execution records it describes authenticate who ran the verifier, or authorize any downstream export. See authentication_scope_statement in verification-execution-record.schema.json.
